title: Remove flaky linked-panel geometry coverage
context: A rounded linked-panel resize assertion intermittently races native hover delivery after viewport changes. Responsive pointer geometry remains covered by the slanted-panel suite, so the duplicate loop can be removed without weakening core behavior coverage.

tasks.title: Remove the flaky duplicate resize loop
acceptance_criteria: The keyboard and reduced-motion test no longer performs native pointer assertions immediately after viewport resize or scroll
It continues to verify static keyboard feedback, reduced-motion behavior, and keyboard link navigation
Responsive slanted-panel pointer, breakpoint, and scroll coverage remains intact
